messages:
mike.prod: Quick update 

Were bringing Dedicated 'Nimbus-240G' capacity to us-central1 (iowa) as a GA launch with an initial soft-quota. Provisioning window: 2026-07-10 02:00-04:00 UTC. Docs + perf: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated/nimbus-us-central
tara.ops: Soft-quota details: self-serve reservations allowed but per-account replica cap = 6 for first 72h. Enterprise customers may request higher caps via infra-ops.
ops-bot: @channel Provisioning ETA: 2026-07-10 02:00-04:00 UTC. Expect CA scaling in us-central1. No planned customer-facing downtime.
sam.sales: Sales note: do not promise immediate unlimited capacity. We'll share the quota sheet and migration guidance in ~45m.
joel.sre: Hardware summary: Nimbus-240G = ~240 TF infer-class, 320GB HBM, tuned kernels for ultra-long context KV caching and high-memory models. Benchmarks: excellent long-seq throughput and stable tail latency under batching.
devex: When customers migrate, will Console show recommended tuning (batching, kv sizes)?
mike.prod: Yes Console shows a Nimbus checklist and suggested params. Posting a sample autoscale snippet for infra:
``` 
# Nimbus autoscale example
pool: nimbus-us-central-1
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 24
burst_slots: 6
tenant_replica_default_cap: 6
```
joel.sre: Policy change: for Nimbus GA were enabling cross-zone burst fallback but capped. Cross-zone burst will be allowed only if local zone utilization > 90% and only up to 2 borrowed replicas per tenant. This reduces hard isolation but improves availability.
tara.ops: Operational constraint: to reduce noisy neighbor risk we'll set an eviction threshold earlier during the first 48h and ramp it down after stability checks. If customers require sustained >6 replicas, they must file infra-ops with workload profile.
sam.sales: Billing: per-token pricing unchanged. There will be a one-time "nimbus_early" 11% uplift for reservations created in the first billing cycle to cover rollout costs. Remove after stabilization window.
docs-team: Draft customer bulletin is ready in #eng-runtime. I posted the migration playbook, rollback steps, and FAQ. Please review.
devex: I'll add a one-click quickstart and a pre-migration checklist to the Console flow.
joel.sre: Oncall will monitor tail-latency, cache hit-rate, and evictions during the window. Tag @joel.sre if you spot spike in 5xxs or p50/p99 tail.
mike.prod: Final ask: no outbound customer promises about instant unlimited capacity until quotas lifted (target 2026-07-13). We'll send the official customer bulletin 2026-07-09 09:00 UTC. Thanks all :rocket:
